remarks: New opportunity:BOM due to non-performance! This house was built with care by the heirs grandfather and father. There is enormous potential with some TLC and updating. It was used as a multi-generational home until it was rented out 10 years ago as a single family home. It is in a 2 family zone and would require the necessary steps through the zoning and building depts to be a legal 2 family. FYI, tax record and online field card erronously list as a 2 family. Enter home through arched doorway. 1st floor is open floor plan living room/dining room/kitchen,1 bedoom with bathroom and laundry room. Living room and dining room have built-ins. Hardwood floors have been redone and carpet in 1st floor bedroom was replaced.Short staricase through arched doorway to 2nd floor. 2nd floor has bedroom with redone hardwood floors, hall bath and what was a kitchen. Gas for stove upstairs has been capped off and all appliances removed. 3rd floor bedroom has new carpet. Entire house was repainted in the interior. Deep, flat backyard. Property next door is owned by muncipality with large fenced yard, mature trees and 2 water towers. Roof and hot water heater 8 years, furnace( just serviced) and oil tank 12 years.Stove is gas from town. This is a great little house just needs some love again. Sold AS-AS. No credits or concessions.
